description: Trim playlist to N items (keep first/last/random) by OVERWRITING the playlist: every row outside the kept set is DELETED, and the kept rows are re-written in the new order. An overwrite that deletes rows asks for confirmation first. Quota: 2 walks of the playlist items + 2 metadata GETs + PUT/POST.

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate inputs and describe exactly what would change without performing it

keep_which.description: Which end of the playlist to keep items from. Default first

playlist_id.description: Playlist ID, spotify:playlist: URI, or URL

name: playlist_trim
